title: DashboardStats
description: Pre-aggregated stats, computed server-side over the in-memory run list. Returned by GET /api/dashboard. No 'difficulty' or 'byLanguage' breakdown — MVP has one language (no information in that chart) and no way to assess difficulty (dropped, not deferred).

fixRate.description: Null when totalRuns is 0 — 'no data yet' is not the same as '0%'.

byCategory.description: All three keys always present, defaulting to 0 — fixed to the three families in taxonomy.json.

byType.description: Keyed by taxonomy item key. Open map, not enumerated here, so this schema doesn't need updating whenever taxonomy.json's item list changes.
